why: इत्युवाच वचः क्रूरं 'spoke thus cruel words' is correct and fits the sense.
त्रिशिरसा is the name Trishiras (instrumental), slain with Dushana.
न चाधर्मेण = न च अधर्मेण, correct sandhi and sense.
अधर्मेण संयुक्ताः is the intended sense (adharma making the twice-born dull).
वैकृतम् 'disfigurement' fits the faces of the dead.
महाशनिः 'great thunderbolt' fits गिराविव and सहस्राक्षसमुत्सृष्टा.
महात्मनम् is no valid form; genitive plural महात्मनाम् (in the mansions of the great) is needed and keeps 8 syllables.
महास्वनाम् 'loud-sounding' agrees with शक्तिम् अष्टघण्टाम्.
रघुनङ्गनः is a broken conjunct for रघुनन्दनः.

suggest: स तं भ्रातरमाश्वास्य परिष्वज्य च राघवः
why: The prefix परि does not lengthen; पारिष्वज्य is not a form, परिष्वज्य keeps the metre.
प्रमुमोच (released) is a regular perfect of प्र-मुच्.
स्त्रीसहस्राणि सप्त 'seven thousand women' is correct.
ह्यविज्ञाय = हि अविज्ञाय 'not knowing your might', correct.
सुजीवितम् 'well lived' is a normal intensifying compound.

suggest: आत्मानं च नरश्रेष्ठ मम वाक्यमिदं शृणु
why: नररेष्ठ is a dropped श् in the vocative नरश्रेष्ठ.

suggest: स लक्ष्मणः कृष्णमृगं हत्वा मेध्यं प्रतापवान्
why: पतापवान् lacks the र् of प्रतापवान्.
धिङ् मे जन्म सजीवितम् 'fie on my birth together with life' is correct.
सेवितम् 'frequented by gods, sages and apsaras' is the right word.
जीविताम् is not a regular form (जीवताम् would fit the sense but shortens the pada); cannot decide from the lines.
महाधनं महत् 'great wealth' fits the sense; ॑ is the pada marker.
स्मरिष्यामि 'I shall not remember mother or father' is correct.
भरिष्यामि 'how shall I support' fits the blind mother context.
चरिष्यामि 'I shall roam with you' is correct.
हरिष्यामि 'I shall carry off (Sita)' is correct.
महामीनं 'great fish' belongs to the sky-as-ocean imagery of the passage.
न विपद्यते 'does not perish' fits the sense.
महास्वनं 'loudly' as adverb with रुरोद is correct.
महादानं 'great gifts' with प्रयच्छति is correct.
लवणेन is the name Lavana (the asura of Madhupura).
वानरीणां 'of female monkeys' parallels किन्नरीणां.
चाविशेषतः = च अविशेषतः, correct and echoed in the previous line.
वाशुभम् = वा अशुभम्, correct sandhi.
सुस्थितम् 'firmly established' is correct.
दासोऽहं 'I am the servant of' is correct.
चासदृशं = च असदृशं 'unbefitting', correct.
सुसदृशं 'very fitting' is correct.
ह्यसदृशं = हि असदृशं, correct sandhi.
संस्थितम् 'standing like Kailasa' is correct.
त्वसदृशं = तु असदृशं, correct sandhi.
सुमहातेजाः is a normal intensified epithet.
मत्ता इव महागजाः 'like rutting great elephants' is correct.

suggest: रामः सौमित्रिणा सार्धं सभार्यः संविवेश ह
why: संविवेश is fine, but सार्धम् needs the instrumental सौमित्रिणा; the anusvara is a stray.
विरोचते 'shines forth' fits the sense.
महाबहुः is missing the ा of महाबाहुः.
एतस्मिन्नन्तेरे has a stray े; the word is अन्तरे.
रोचयते (causative, 'approves of') is correct and keeps the metre.
विविधात्मनि agrees with पुष्पके, correct.
रशरथो is a wrong akshara for दशरथो.
विचिक्षेप 'flung about (the tail)' is correct.
अर्जुनेन is Kartavirya Arjuna who released Ravana.
लोकस्तस्य = लोकः तस्य, correct sandhi.
अनिहत्य 'without slaying' is correct.
सरुधिरं 'covered with blood' is correct.
भवत्विति = भवतु इति, correct.
जामातरं 'son-in-law' is the right word for Janaka's view of Rama.
महाबिलम् 'great cave' is confirmed by सुमहद्बिलम् in the next line.
सर्वबूतानां has ब for भ in सर्वभूतानां.
सुमहाबलम् is a normal intensified epithet.
गच्छन्त्विति = गच्छन्तु इति, correct.
दशक्रीवः has क for ग in दशग्रीवः.
